Definition: third person singular of the same as G5530 or G5531 used impersonally; it needs (must or should) be:--ought.
BiblicalUsage: James says blessing and cursing come from the same mouth, and adds that these things ought not to be so. The word is small — it ought not — but it carries the whole weight of the rebuke.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe James is right: a mouth that blesses God cannot rightly curse the people made in His likeness.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
